banner.lead: AI pre-visit assistant, not a doctor.
banner.rest: No diagnosis, no prescriptions. Please don't enter real medical records or personal details.

chat.title: Pre-visit
chat.startBody: Answer a few questions and we will put them into a summary for your doctor. Finish it before your appointment.
chat.startStep1: One question at a time. Answer in your own words.
chat.startStep2: You check the summary before it goes to your doctor.
chat.startStep3: If you mention danger signs like chest pain or trouble breathing, you are told to get care right away. The AI is not involved.
chat.missingBody: It may be past the retention period. Start a new pre-visit.
chat.piiMasked: Your message had what looks like personal details. They were masked before processing. Please don't enter real personal details.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.tooLong: Over the limit. Shorten it before sending.
composer.handoff: Ask a doctor to contact me
composer.paused: This pre-visit is paused. Messages won't be sent to the AI.
composer.closed: This pre-visit has been sent. You can't add to it.
composer.emergencyNote: If your symptoms get worse, call 119 or go to an emergency room.

emergency.title: Get medical help now
emergency.titleMind: You are not alone. Someone can talk with you right now.
emergency.ticket: The care team has been notified (ticket {{no}}).
emergency.fallback: Your symptoms may be serious. Call 119 now, or have someone take you to the nearest emergency room. Don't drive yourself.
emergency.fallbackMind: Call the 1925 hotline now. Someone answers 24 hours a day. In immediate danger, call 119.

summary.complete: All required fields are filled in.
summary.byModel: Written by AI from the conversation ({{model}}, {{time}}).
summary.byCode: Built by code from the fields so far, not AI ({{time}}).
summary.sent: Sent to the doctor, who will read this summary before your visit.

submit.title: Send to the doctor?
submit.body: You can't edit after sending. Send what you have to the doctor?
submit.missing_one: {{count}} item is unanswered. It will be marked as not collected.
submit.missing_other: {{count}} items are unanswered. They will be marked as not collected.

handoff.title: Ask a doctor to contact you
handoff.body: We will open a handoff ticket, and a doctor or pharmacist will get in touch.
handoff.note: Anything you want the doctor to know (optional)
handoff.done: The care team has been notified. Ticket

trace.empty2: Each step will appear here once you start.

tool.red_flag_precheck: Red-flag check: code scans every message first
tool.scope_precheck: Scope check: is it asking for a prescription or out of bounds
tool.output_guard: Output check: looks for diagnosis, doses or prescriptions before a reply goes out
tool.record_intake: Writes what the patient said into the intake fields

guard.rewritten: The output check rewrote the reply ({{kind}})
guard.replaced: The output check replaced the reply ({{kind}})

brief.scopePrescription: Asked for a prescription or medicine advice
brief.scopeInjection: Asked to ignore the rules or reveal settings
brief.refillConsult: Result: ask a pharmacist or doctor
brief.transferDeduped: An open ticket already existed; reused {{ticket}}
brief.guardReplaced: Reply contained {{violations}} and was replaced with fixed text

refill.intro: Enter what is on the prescription. Code works out, by NHI rules, whether you can refill. No AI is involved.
refill.exampleNote: The form starts with example dates. Change them to the dates on the prescription.
refill.fillsHint: If all three fills are collected, choose 3.
refill.controlled: Does it include a Schedule 1 or 2 controlled drug
refill.sideEffects: I felt unwell after taking it (side effects)
refill.demoToggle: Use the date below as today
refill.todayHint: When unchecked, the server date is used ({{date}}).

errors.after_today: The date can't be after today
errors.before_prescription: The last fill can't be before the prescription date
errors.per_fill_exceeds_total: Days per fill can't exceed the total

refill.ticketLead: The care team has been notified. Ticket

errors.offline: The connection dropped, so the message wasn't sent. Reconnect and try again.
errors.offlineLoad: This pre-visit couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.notFound: That wasn't found. It may be past the retention period.
errors.visitClosed: This pre-visit has been sent. You can't add to it.
errors.conflict: The previous message is still being processed. Wait for the reply, then send again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.tooLarge: That's too long. Shorten it and send again.
errors.invalidRequest: Something in the form isn't valid. Check it and send again.
errors.invalidState: This can't be done in its current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.internal: The server couldn't finish that request. Try again in a moment.
errors.budget: The AI can't reply right now. Today's quota is used up. Red-flag checks and refill checks still work, and you can use "Finish and send" to hand what you have to the doctor.
errors.timeout: The AI took too long to reply. Send it again.
errors.modelDown: The AI can't reply right now. Red-flag checks and refill checks still work. Try again later, or use "Finish and send".

safety.title: Safety boundaries
safety.lead: This tool only organises information before a visit and works out, by NHI rules, whether a refill is allowed. Judgement stays with doctors and pharmacists. These six boundaries are the ones it will not cross, with how each is kept.

disclosure.title: It says it is an AI from the start
disclosure.body: The first message of every pre-visit is fixed text: "I am an AI pre-visit assistant, not a doctor."

redFlag.title: Red-flag rules come before the AI
redFlag.body: Chest pain, trouble breathing, thoughts of self-harm and similar are matched by code first. A match gets fixed text and shows 119 and 1925.

noAdvice.title: No diagnosis, no prescriptions, no doses
noAdvice.body: Limits in the prompt, plus an output check. A reply that breaks them is rewritten or refused.

refill.title: Refill checks give four results only
refill.body: Code applies the NHI rules. Controlled drugs, changed symptoms and side effects always go to a pharmacist or doctor.

audit.title: Every step can be traced
audit.body: Tool calls, red-flag results and model names are recorded in the trace panel and the database.

privacy.title: No personal details collected
privacy.body: It never asks for a name or ID number, and stores only a de-identified summary, kept for {{days}} days.

safety.evalNone: No evaluation has been run yet.
safety.loadFailed: The evaluation results couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
safety.demoNote: This is a demo system. Enter made-up symptoms only. On the free tier, what you send may be used by the model provider to improve its products.

clinician.loginLead: This demo has a single clinician account.
clinician.visitMissing: This pre-visit wasn't found. It may be past the retention period.
clinician.noSummaryYet: The patient hasn't sent it yet. These are the fields collected so far.
clinician.reviewPlaceholder: For example: phoned the patient, who is on the way to the ER
clinician.reviewNotYet: You can mark it reviewed after the patient sends it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has been removed.
